messages:
Laura Chen: Quick heads-up 11 we need to finalize artifacts for the ACME marketplace listing before EOD Friday. Required: SOC2 report, redacted pen-test summary, supplier questionnaire, signed NDA, and a partner-only bundle. Who can confirm locations?
Samir Patel: Ill pull SOC2 + pen-test from the vault and stage. Need redaction rules from Security/Legal.
Rachel Gomez: Redaction guidance: remove private IPs, internal hostnames, full exploit PoCs, and Device model numbers for public bundle. Keep summary of findings, mitigation steps, and timelines.
Tom Nguyen: ACME requested device model numbers removed from public artifacts and a separate bundle for partner engineering. Also asked for an attestation about firmware telemetry.
Laura Chen: Proposed workflow: 1) Samir exports artifacts to staging bucket with 48h TTL. 2) Rachel performs redaction and produces two bundles (public + partner). 3) Legal approves attestation wording. 4) Tom coordinates the partner handoff and marketplace upload.
Samir Patel: Will upload to s3://redwood-marketplace-staging/acme-2125001234/ and create presigned links TTL=48h. Will tag objects marketplace-evidence.
Maya (Compliance Bot): Reminder: presigned links to external parties require DLP signoff. Add object_tag=marketplace-evidence and enable access_logging. Retention default 90 days. See https://internal.redwood/docs/compliance/presign-guidelines
Rachel Gomez: Short redaction checklist Im using:
```
- redact private IPs and internal hostnames
- remove raw PoC exploit code blocks
- replace emails with <redacted@company>
- remove firmware model numbers from public artifacts
- generate redaction_manifest.csv describing changes
```
I will submit the manifest to Legal for wording approval.
Tom Nguyen: ACME also asked for a signed letter saying we did not modify telemetry fields during redaction. Legal wants a draft to review.
Laura Chen: Ill draft the attestation. Rachel, please add one-line confirmation in the manifest: "Redaction preserved telemetry schema; no telemetry values were altered."
Rachel Gomez: Will add that line and include checksums for telemetry files pre/post-redaction (hashes preserved for non-redacted fields).
Samir Patel: Raw zip uploaded and tags set. Presigned links posted to #private-ops. TTL 48h.
Maya (Compliance Bot): Auto-check passed: tag present, access logging enabled. Note: DLP review pending if links go external.
Tom Nguyen: Scheduling partner handoff call tomorrow 10am PT. Inviting ACME PM, Legal, Security, and Eng.
Laura Chen: Owners: Samir = upload + presigns; Rachel = redact + manifest; Tom = partner handoff + upload; Laura = attestation draft + final signoff. Flag blockers here.
Samir Patel: On it. Will post status here after Legal checks presigns. :thumbsup:
Rachel Gomez: Starting redaction once Samir confirms links. ETA Thurs 12:00 PT.
Tom Nguyen: Invite sent; ACME confirmed.
Laura Chen: Thanks all. If Legal requests stricter redaction, well loop in Product Comms for marketplace copy adjustments.
